questions.coherence: The harness commits form one design. M18.191 adds jobs(id) to the one ci-runs source, and both M18.192's new ci-run-red.mjs and last-ci use it, with one FAILED set (failure, timed_out, startup_failure) in both. M18.192's ciFixProblem is injected into landingBlock by both land.mjs and check-checkpoint, so the rule holds in both places. M18.178 extends the same last-ci cold-setup path rather than adding a second. M18.193 changes only where committedDigest reads from. M18.190 cleanly reverts M18.180's second termination path, so the witness again has one owned termination path, which matches the installed probe's contract (cp24 F2's contradiction is gone). One incoherence: the landing mark is a substring of the title. Rows whose titles describe the mechanism, M18.181 and M18.192, are parsed as marks, and M18.192 was an unplanned second mark for seven hours (F3).
questions.specFidelity: M18.191, M18.192 and M18.193 meet their EARS, apart from M18.192's argued pending-run deviation. M18.178 meets its EARS (both annotation forms, duration UNKNOWN, renamed title with a Renames-test trailer), and its mark closed on real three-OS evidence. M18.194 meets its EARS: per-OS expressions are pinned in ci-workflow.test, ADR-0209 is added, and no test or threshold changed. M18.190's EARS is not shown to hold on Windows: 'WHEN the owned browser has exited inside the two-second cleanup reserve ... report a clean close'. Its diagnosis that pack-import's failure was 'a misreport, not a slow close' rests on the probe's traces, because pack-import prints none. Two of the four Windows verify runs after it failed with the same message in cli.pack-import: '129 members, one more than a Node witness session admits' at e3f6e36 and '50-SVG corpus ... folder and a ZIP' at db19f11. questions.gateHonesty: Nothing is weakened by thresholds or deletions, and both removed tests carry trailers. M18.194 lengthens macOS's verify step timeout from 15 to 20 minutes. That is ADR-backed (ADR-0209, the ADR-0197 precedent) and does not loosen thresholds.mjs, but the cause, a step that grew from 754 to over 900 s in four runs, is not tracked by any row on main (F4). The main gap: a single green run now closes a mark and prints green while a job fails intermittently. ci-evidence.json records ceb8246, and last-ci exits 0 at 'ci green at ceb8246'. Yet ci 40905801401 at db19f11, whose product tree equals ceb8246's (ceb8246 changes only .github/ and docs), has verify (windows-latest) failed with the M18.190 error. last-ci reads only the newest completed run and newer pending ones, and check-ci-evidence reads only the run it records, so a roughly 50% Windows failure passes every gate after one lucky run. That is run-level retry by another name (F2). Spot-checked mutants. (1) Dropping the jobs read in last-ci's pending branch fails 'M18.191: a failed job in a pending run is red...'. (2) Deleting the spent check in ciFixProblem fails checkpoint.test.mjs:417 and land.test.mjs:447. (3) Reverting setImmediate to a direct read fails svg-witness-cleanup-loop.test.ts's held-loop clean close, which the commit says fails on 084008f. The tests constrain the code they target. The completion gate is 55/75 with honest reds. Its 'three-OS CI' leg reads one run (F2).
questions.architecture: No pure-package change in the delta. M18.190 touches only packages/cli on the node side and reverts M18.180's process-type extension (adding `immediate`). It has no public API, file-format or contract change and no new dependency (lockfile unchanged). The NFR-SEC-001 contract is restored: on Windows the browser ends only through the owned taskkill spawn, and injected failures are reported. ci-run-red.mjs adds a live GitHub read to the landing path. An unreadable answer refuses, so the failure mode is closed. ADR-0209 is the only new ADR and is correctly indexed. ADR-0207/0208 are claimed by stream 6 but absent from main, which is consistent with ADR-0210 being next free.

findings.failure_scenario: The font thread's five commits land over a main whose Windows verify fails about half the time. Each red is then ambiguous between this flake and a real regression, and the next agent either reruns until green, which is a retry by another name, or writes attempt 3 of the witness thread without the independent diagnostic review ADR-0176 and cp24's argue line require. Meanwhile a real Windows user's pack-import of 50 or more SVGs intermittently fails with 'cleanup', or the verdict hides a browser that did not end.
findings.recommendation: Reopen as a `blocks-landing` row. First make pack-import's cleanup failure print the deciding branch and timings, and get a Windows failure with that trace (or a local reproduction) before an independent diagnostic review. Then code the fix as attempt 3 with `Fixes-ci: 40905801401`. Close only after verify (windows-latest) is green on three consecutive ci runs at or after the fix (at a 50% failure rate, three lucky greens is a 12.5% chance). M18.190 closes with it.

findings.failure_scenario: Any intermittent platform failure passes every gate the first time one run comes up green. Marks close on it, last-ci invites feature batches, and the zero-retry policy is bypassed at run level, because a second push or a cancelled-and-requeued run is a retry. This is cp12's failure mode, 'last-ci hid it', again, behind an older red instead of behind pending runs.
findings.recommendation: Make check-ci-evidence and last-ci read every ci run on the branch since the last product-path commit, and refuse or print INTERMITTENT while a job that failed there has not been green in two later completed runs. Add harness cases built from these runs.

findings.failure_scenario: A future row about the landing mechanism, for example a last-ci change that 'names the open `blocks-landing` row', silently blocks every feature commit until three-OS evidence exists. Its author cannot remove the accidental mark without that evidence either, so an unrelated harness row couples to main's CI state.
findings.recommendation: Treat the mark only as the title's last token, shared by land.mjs and check-checkpoint, with a harness case for a mid-title mention.

findings.failure_scenario: At the recorded growth (about 50 s per harness-heavy batch), the step reaches 1200 s within roughly six batches. A further envelope ADR then follows the same pattern (ADR-0191, 0197, 0209), and timeouts ratchet up while every run gets slower.
